harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt router) to route between lan-a (node2, eth1, 192.168.10.0/24) and lan-b (node3, eth1, 192.168.20.0/24), each previously-unconfigured NIC brought up with a static IP. Added firewall4 zones lan_a/lan_b (forward=REJECT default) plus a single explicit rule permitting only TCP/5432 from lan_a to lan_b; removed an initial mistake (blanket 'config forwarding' sections that unconditionally accepted all traffic) once discovered via nft ruleset inspection. Also had to open a source-scoped firewalld rich-rule on node3 (192.168.10.0/24 -> tcp/5432 only) since AlmaLinux's host firewall was independently blocking the port. Verified: node2->node3:5432 succeeds; node2->node3 other ports and ping refused; node3->node2 (any port/ping) refused — satisfying the bidirectional 'refuse everything else' requirement. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time (boot_id changed on each, confirming true reboots), and post-restart the persisted UCI/network/firewalld config and functional TCP/5432-only policy were re-verified end to end.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2/node3 network and firewall baseline state
Configured node1 UCI network interfaces lan_a (eth1, 192.168.10.1/24) and lan_b (eth2, 192.168.20.1/24)
Set static IPs and static routes on node2 (192.168.10.11/24) and node3 (192.168.20.11/24) via nmcli persistent connection profiles
Configured OpenWrt firewall4 zones lan_a/lan_b with forward=REJECT and one rule allowing tcp/5432 from lan_a to lan_b
Discovered and removed erroneous blanket 'config forwarding' sections that bypassed the port restriction
Added a source-scoped firewalld rich-rule on node3 to permit tcp/5432 only from 192.168.10.0/24
Functionally verified allowed (5432) and refused (other ports, ping, reverse direction) traffic with socat/ping
Captured boot_id and health baseline on all three nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially (one at a time), confirming each via changed boot_id and command-execution availability
Re-verified persisted configuration and functional TCP/5432-only policy after each restart and at the end
Cleaned up all test listener processes/files on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node2 can reach node3 on TCP 5432
evidence.summary: socat TCP connect from node2 to 192.168.20.11:5432 succeeds (exit=0), both before and after all node restarts

evidence.requirement: All other node2<->node3 connections refused (both directions)
evidence.summary: node2->node3:5433 refused, node2->node3 ping refused, and node3->node2:5432/ping refused (reverse direction), confirming symmetric denial except the allowed port

evidence.requirement: Correct nftables rule installed on node1 (bug found and fixed)
evidence.summary: Initial ruleset showed forwarding sections causing blanket accept; removed them and confirmed forward_lan_a only accepts tcp/5432 with fallback reject, forward_lan_b fully rejects

evidence.requirement: node1 boot-identity baseline and healthy config before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id eed61249... plus healthy eth1/eth2 addresses and active network/firewall services

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot command returned immediately; subsequent exec timed out confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: boot_id changed to dc38975a..., proving a real reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of config and service health
evidence.summary: UCI firewall/network config, nftables rules, and interface addresses all persisted; functional 5432-allow/ping-reject test passed post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 boot-identity baseline and healthy config before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id a4139d3b... plus static IP/route config on eth1

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, disconnect, and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot scheduled and acknowledged, node went unreachable, then boot_id changed to baa77bf5..., proving restart

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery of config and functional connectivity
evidence.summary: nmcli confirms static IP/route persisted; socat to node3:5432 succeeds post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 boot-identity baseline and healthy config before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 67f3a44b... plus firewalld rich-rule and static IP/route config

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, disconnect, and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot scheduled and acknowledged, node went unreachable, then boot_id changed to 87eeca3e..., proving restart

evidence.requirement: node3 post-restart recovery of config and full end-to-end policy verification
evidence.summary: Static IP/route and firewalld rich-rule persisted; final end-to-end test after all three restarts shows 5432 allowed, other port and ping refused; test listeners cleaned up
